scope: Proposition 6.1 (Orbit cancellation) of the manuscript “Rokhlin's multiple-mixing problem for one transformation” (preprints/Rokhlins-multiple-mixing-problem-for-one-transformation-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 145 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 45000cec6bcec95d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 33. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume that X is a mixing two-sided finite-alphabet stationary process whose alphabet partition has entropy rate zero. For every centered finite-valued one-site function f on X, every probability coupling x : Y → X, every family satisfying (60), every automorphism G, and every l ∈ L, one has lim N→∞ 1 N N−1 X r=0 Z f(Tr Xx)χGrl dη = 0.
